case_name: In Re APPLICATION OF ENBRIDGE ENERGY TO REPLACE AND RELOCATE LINE 5

issues.label: Scope of Act 16 authority
issues.why: The court must determine whether the 1953 easement/approval covers relocation or whether new PSC authorization under MCL 483.1 et seq. was required.

issues.label: Standard of review of PSC decision
issues.why: The court must apply the deferential lawful-and-reasonable standard governing appellate review of PSC orders.

issues.label: Public convenience and necessity showing
issues.why: Whether Enbridge demonstrated the pipeline replacement serves public need under Act 16 given limited Michigan use.

issues.label: MEPA applicability and compliance
issues.why: Whether the PSC was required to consider environmental impacts under MEPA/NREPA in approving the application.

issues.label: Scope of PSC's environmental review duty
issues.why: Whether the PSC properly limited its inquiry to the pipeline segment rather than the tunnel, spill risk, or upstream/downstream effects.

issues.label: Article 4, Section 52 obligations
issues.why: Whether the constitutional mandate to protect natural resources constrains the PSC's approval decision.

issues.label: Prudent alternatives analysis
issues.why: Whether feasible and prudent alternatives, including no-build or decommissioning, had to be evaluated.

issues.label: Segmentation of the project
issues.why: Whether the tunnel and pipeline could properly be reviewed separately from each other and from other approvals.

issues.label: Treaty fishing rights consideration
issues.why: Whether the PSC was required to account for tribal treaty-reserved fishing and usufructuary rights.

issues.label: Tribal consultation obligations
issues.why: Whether meaningful consultation with affected Indian Tribes was legally required and satisfied.

issues.label: Public trust doctrine
issues.why: Whether the Great Lakes public trust imposes duties limiting or conditioning approval of Straits construction.

issues.label: Standing of appellants
issues.why: Whether the Tribes and other appellants have standing to challenge the PSC's approval.

issues.label: Preclusive effect of Dehn/1953 approval
issues.why: Whether the prior approval and rejected collateral attack bar or limit current challenges.

issues.label: Effect of 2018 PA 359 and MSCA agreements
issues.why: Whether the statutory tunnel authority and easement affect the scope of PSC's required review.

issues.label: Adequacy of evidentiary record
issues.why: Whether substantial competent evidence supported the PSC's findings on safety and necessity.

issues.label: Spill and anchor-strike risk assessment
issues.why: Whether the PSC adequately considered catastrophic spill risks in evaluating the application.

issues.label: Burden of proof allocation
issues.why: Whether Enbridge properly bore and met the preponderance burden on the relevant issues.

issues.label: Co-location denial's severability
issues.why: Whether the PSC's rejection of third-party utilities affects the validity of the remaining approval.

issues.label: Interstate/foreign commerce and preemption
issues.why: Whether federal pipeline safety law or the Commerce Clause limits state review authority.

issues.label: Governor's agreements' legal effect
issues.why: Whether the executive agreements bind or improperly constrain the PSC's independent determination.

issues.label: Cumulative environmental impacts
issues.why: Whether long-term climate and downstream hydrocarbon impacts had to be assessed.

issues.label: Scope of relief and remedy
issues.why: Whether remand, reversal, or additional conditions are appropriate if error is found.
